semiconductor_relevance: High — NSW Automation specializes in precision dispensing systems crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: NSW Automation is a leading provider of precision liquid dispensing systems tailored for the microelectronics and semiconductor industries. Their solutions are designed to meet the demands of advanced packaging technologies and are widely utilized in applications such as AI, EV components, and 5G communication equipment.
